exercises.name: Dead-hang on Jugs
exercises.description: Dead-hang on jug holds for warm-up and endurance.

exercises.name: Dead-hang on smallest edge
exercises.description: Intermittent dead-hangs on the smallest edge.

exercises.name: Max finger strength
exercises.description: Max finger strength (usually half-crimp) weighted hangs (90-100% of your maximum). Hangboard exercise designed to increase the maximum force your fingers can produce, useful especially for hard bouldering and difficult cruxes. Stop if grip position breaks down. For weaker climbers the same exercise can be done with assistance (e.g. pulley/band) to reach the appropriate intensity.

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.description: Standard push-ups for antagonist training.

exercises.name: Strength Endurance Hangboard
exercises.description: Hangboard strength-endurance protocol using repeated 7-second hangs with 3 seconds of rest. Use a moderate-high intensity that allows all repetitions with controlled grip position. Designed to improve the ability to sustain repeated high-intensity finger contractions and tolerate pump.

exercises.name: No-hangs Hangboard
exercises.description: Sub-maximal isometric finger loading on a hangboard with feet on the ground (~30-50% max effort) to promote finger health, tendon collagen synthesis, and warm-up readiness without fatigue.

exercises.name: Megos PE Finger Training
exercises.description: Alex Megos's finger training protocol for power endurance. Hang with both arms on an edge that you can finnish the exercise on.

exercises.name: Hangboard PE Finger Training
exercises.description: Hangboard standard finger training protocol for power endurance. Hang with both arms on an edge that you can finnish the exercise on.

exercises.name: Finger Curls on Hangboard
exercises.description: Finger curls on hangboard with your feet on. Can be used as warm-up.

exercises.name: Finger Lifting weights
exercises.description: Lift weights with each hand. 5 reps of 25sec per hand.

exercises.name: 2on 2off
exercises.description: 2 minutes on the wall, 2 minutes off the wall. No hard pump. Primarily aerobic/low-intensity endurance training

exercises.name: Bechtel 5min
exercises.description: Fast, 5 min Bechtel's workout. Each min do 3 to 5 pull-ups or push-ups then rest the remaining minute.

exercises.name: Shoulder Isometric
exercises.description: Shoulder Isometric 30 sec

exercises.name: Easy Routes Autobelay
exercises.description: 4x6 easy routes on autobelay for aerobic endurance.

exercises.name: Fryer 2016 Endurance Program
exercises.description: Tom Fryer's endurance protocol (2016) for sustained climbing capacity (50-60%). No hard pump.

exercises.name: 1 On 1 Off Endurance
exercises.description: Climb 1 minute, rest 1 minute. Repeat for endurance development.

exercises.name: Stretching
exercises.description: Full body stretching session focused on shoulders, hips, and forearms.

exercises.name: Outdoor Climbing
exercises.description: Outdoor climbing session on rock.

exercises.name: Bouldering High Intensity
exercises.description: 1 hour, low volume, low fatigue, high intensity bouldering session, working limit problems (7-12 total attempts). Climb 3-5 move problems (5-10 seconds per attempt) with 3-5 minutes of rest between goes.

exercises.name: Bouldering
exercises.description: 1 hour bouldering session. Best done on boards.

exercises.name: Kenees Program
exercises.description: Knee rehabilitation/prehab program.

exercises.name: Wall Crawling
exercises.description: Move on the wall and take 4-7 sec break between moves on small holds

exercises.name: Intensive Triples
exercises.description: ~45 min: 1 round = 3 min climbing (one flash-level boulder per minute) + 3 min rest. Set 1: 3 rounds (18 min). Big rest: 8-10 min. Set 2: 3 rounds (18 min).

exercises.name: CARCing
exercises.description: Continuous Aerobic Regenerative Climbing - easy climbing for recovery and capillarity.

exercises.name: Explosive Pull-ups
exercises.description: Explosive/dynamic pull-ups for upper body power.

exercises.name: Warm-up Paradigm Climbing
exercises.description: Progressive climbing warm-up: 2 min jumping jacks (easy cardio), arm circles/leg swings/finger movement (tendon glides), scapular pull-ups/asymmetric lock-offs/progressive hangs/easy climbing, quick dead-points/explosive pull-ups.

exercises.name: Max Force Repeatability
exercises.description: Short max-output finger hangs focused on force repeatability. Each rep should be at maximum effort. Rest fully between reps and sets to maintain quality. Best done on an edge.
